title: NeuPortal Forecast Ledger: Bitcoin-timestamped AI forecasts scored against market prices
description:
Every forecast in this dataset is timestamped into Bitcoin with OpenTimestamps and scored against market prices with the Brier score. Since 26 September 2026 each prediction-market call is sealed minutes after it is made, before its event. Each JSON file is the original stamped artifact, byte for byte, next to its .ots proof.

The first prediction-market batch (1,613 calls from 14–26 September 2026) was sealed late, on 26 September; 1,394 of those calls had already resolved by then and are not evidence of forecasting in advance. On them our Brier is 0.187 against the market's 0.164; without them the totals are ours 0.196, the market's 0.160.

As of 7 November 2026: 7,294 forecasts, 6,957 resolved. Brier score: ours 0.1936, the market's 0.1605 (lower is better), so the market is ahead. Tracks: weather, crypto, sports, markets, politics, tech.

Known gaps are listed in the README: newest files may carry pending proofs, one file was never stamped, and a duplicate set sealed by mistake is kept but not scored.

Verify any file at opentimestamps.org (drop the .ots first, then the .json) or with the opentimestamps-client.
